name: Resources Checklist (TRIZ)
description: Systematic inventory of substances, fields, space, time, information and functions
whenToUse: When you want to inventory what the system and its environment already provide at no cost, before searching for solutions — not to judge solutions or resolve contradictions.
systemPlaceholder: e.g. belt conveyor for bulk solids

substance.name: Substances
substance.prompt: Materials, parts, waste, by-products, atmosphere, contaminants …

field.name: Fields
field.prompt: Mechanical, thermal, chemical, electrical, magnetic, acoustic, optical, gravitational …

space.name: Space
space.prompt: Unused volumes, surfaces, gaps, cavities, contact regions …

time.name: Time
time.prompt: Idle phases, transitions, pauses between cycles, lead/lag windows …

info.name: Information
info.prompt: Sensor signals, indicators, naturally occurring data, by-product information …

function.name: Function / energy
function.prompt: Existing functions usable for double duty; energy already flowing through the system …
